topic: Reporting a Missing Item in an Order

script.title: A MISSING ITEM IN MY ORDER
script.scene_zh: 客廳 · 客服反映缺件
script.story_hook: One item from the online order never arrived.
script.intro_zh: 線上訂的東西送到時少了一件，只好找客服處理。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today something is missing from an order.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，各位！今天訂單裡少了一件商品。
script.outro: Problem solved, finally! Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 問題終於解決啦！再聽一次，一起跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's practice those lines about missing items.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來練習這些關於缺件的句子。

script.char_b_description: a composed woman in her early forties with pin-straight dark brown hair in a low bun, wearing a soft pink blouse and small hoop earrings, typing while she speaks

script.youtube_title_en: "It Never Showed Up" — Reporting a Missing Item in an Online Order
script.youtube_description:
包裹到了卻少一樣，用英文怎麼跟客服說？這段線上購物的客服對話，教你報訂單編號、傳照片、問補寄與時間。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能自己處理缺件。

script.youtube_description_en:
Box arrived but something is missing? This support chat teaches you how to give the order number, send a photo, and ask about a free replacement. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA and Traditional Chinese, then a repeat-after-me section so you can handle it yourself.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📦網購缺件英文｜報單號・傳照片・問補寄時間｜聽完就會處理｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
包裹到手，裡面卻少了一樣東西？
用英文跟客服反映，要說些什麼？
拍照、補寄、何時送到，怎麼問清楚？

這一集帶大家走進客廳的開箱現場，跟著顧客從報訂單編號、傳照片佐證，到聽懂分裝出貨、確認補寄不收費，全程都是自然的日常美式英語。

你會聽到：
📦 說明缺件：例如「part of my order never showed up.」、「The small glass jar with the blue lid.」。
🔎 查資料與拍照：例如「Got the order number?」、「Can you send a photo of the box?」。
🚚 問補寄與時間：例如「That's a split shipment.」、「When would it reach my door, then?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把跟客服往來的對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次網購少了一件，別急著生氣，好好說幾句就能順利補回來！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up an open empty box

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, part of my order never showed up.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ pɑrt əv maɪ ˈɔrdər nɛvər ʃoʊd ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我訂的東西有一樣都沒送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry about that. Got the order number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt ɡɑt ði ˈɔrdər ˈnʌmbər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪts ˈsɛvən tu naɪn wʌn eɪt eɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. Which item is missing from the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks wɪtʃ ˈaɪtəm ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ frʌm ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。盒子裡少了哪一件？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small glass jar with the blue lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl ɡlæs dʒɑr wɪð ðə blu lɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Can you send a photo of the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kæn ju sɛnd ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 好的。你可以傳一張盒子的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. It looks totally sealed, though.
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過盒子看起來是完全封好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's odd. Was there a second package?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæts ɑd wʌz ðɛr ə ˈsɛkənd ˈpækɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那就奇怪了。有沒有第二個包裹？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, well... a smaller box was outside my door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wɛl ə ˈsmɔlər bɑks wʌz ˈaʊtˌsaɪd maɪ dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 呃……剛剛門口好像有個小一點的箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a split shipment. Different day, same tracking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə splɪt ˈʃɪpmənt ˈdɪfərənt deɪ seɪm ˈtrækɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那是分裝出貨，不同天送，單號相同。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it may already be inside my apartment.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt meɪ ɔlˈrɛdi bi ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ əˈpɑrtmənt/
dialogue.zh: 所以東西可能已經在我家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Possible! Should I still send a replacement?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑsəbəl ʃʊd aɪ stɪl sɛnd ə ˌrɛpleɪsˈmənt/
dialogue.zh: 有可能！那我還要不要補寄一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, but not if it costs me extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz bʌt nɑt ɪf ɪts kɑstz mi ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 好，請補寄，但如果要多收費就別寄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No charge, since the first one went missing.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɑrdʒ sɪns ðə fɜrst wʌn wɛnt ˈmɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不收費，畢竟那件是漏寄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. When would it reach my door, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt wɛn wʊd ɪt riʧ maɪ dɔr ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那什麼時候會送到我家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days, and I'll email you the label.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz ənd aɪl ˈiˌmeɪl ju ðə ˈleɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 兩天，我會把追蹤資訊 email 給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for making this so simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðɪs soʊ ˈsɪmpəl/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你把這麼麻煩的事變得這麼輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Text me if anything else is wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs tɛkst mi ɪf ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls ɪz rɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 應該的！還有別的問題就傳訊息給我。
